name: Make authorization a precondition of provisioning
description: Move approval into the provisioning workflow so that access cannot be granted without a recorded authorisation that names the entitlement and predates the grant, and extend the same path to contractors and external users.
responsible_role: IT / Identity and Access Management owner

steps.action: Define which roles may approve which entitlements, and prohibit self-approval for privileged access.
Route all provisioning through a request workflow in a system of record, so approval and provisioning share one artifact rather than two.
Require the request to name the role or entitlement set, replacing free-text requests for 'access'.
Extend the same path to contractors and external users, who are typically the population handled by exception.
Restrict direct administrative provisioning, and where it must remain possible, alert on it and review it.
Reconcile account creation events against approvals periodically so divergence is detected by the entity rather than by the auditor.

implementation_considerations: Approvals captured in chat feel faster and will persist unless the workflow is genuinely quicker than messaging someone. Invest in the request experience or the process will be bypassed.
Infrastructure-as-code provisioning already carries an approval in the pull request; recognise it as the authorisation rather than layering a second ticket on top.
Prohibiting self-approval outright can block small teams where only one person holds the authority. Define a documented alternate approver before enforcing.
typical_duration: Weeks, mostly spent agreeing the approval matrix rather than configuring the workflow.
prerequisites: A ticketing or identity governance system already used as a system of record
An agreed definition of who may approve what

verification_method.how: Sample accounts and entitlements created after the change and confirm each has an approval that names the entitlement, predates provisioning, and comes from an authorised approver other than the requester.

residual_risk_note: An approval workflow evidences authorisation, not appropriateness. Approvers who rubber-stamp produce compliant records and unchanged risk; the periodic review remains the check on that.
period_limitation_note: Grants made without approval during an elapsed period cannot be retrospectively authorised. A later approval evidences ratification, and an auditor will read it that way.
notes: SOC 2 requires no particular mechanism for authorisation. A version-controlled entitlement definition with reviewed changes is as valid as a ticketing workflow.
